# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # The safe navigation operator returns nil if the receiver is
      # nil. If you chain an ordinary method call after a safe
      # navigation operator, it raises NoMethodError. We should use a
      # safe navigation operator after a safe navigation operator.
      # This cop checks for the problem outlined above.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   x&.foo.bar
      #   x&.foo + bar
      #   x&.foo[bar]
      #
      #   # good
      #   x&.foo&.bar
      #   x&.foo || bar
      class SafeNavigationChain < Base
        include NilMethods
        extend AutoCorrector
        extend TargetRubyVersion

        minimum_target_ruby_version 2.3

        MSG = 'Do not chain ordinary method call after safe navigation operator.'
        PLUS_MINUS_METHODS = %i[+@ -@].freeze

        # @!method bad_method?(node)
        def_node_matcher :bad_method?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (send $(csend ...) $_ ...)
            (send $({block numblock} (csend ...) ...) $_ ...)
          }
        PATTERN

        def on_send(node)
          remember_chain_investigation(node)
          return unless require_safe_navigation?(node)

          bad_method?(node) do |safe_nav, method|
            return if nil_methods.include?(method) || PLUS_MINUS_METHODS.include?(node.method_name)

            begin_range = node.loc.dot || safe_nav.source_range.end
            location = begin_range.join(node.source_range.end)

            add_offense(location) do |corrector|
              autocorrect(corrector, offense_range: location, send_node: node)
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def require_safe_navigation?(node)
          parent = node.parent
          return true unless parent&.and_type?

          parent.rhs != node || parent.lhs.receiver != parent.rhs.receiver
        end

        # @param [Parser::Source::Range] offense_range
        # @param [RuboCop::AST::SendNode] send_node
        # @return [String]
        def add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range:, send_node:)
          source =
            if brackets?(send_node)
              format(
                '%<method_name>s(%<arguments>s)%<method_chain>s',
                arguments: send_node.arguments.map(&:source).join(', '),
                method_name: send_node.method_name,
                method_chain: send_node.source_range.end.join(send_node.source_range.end).source
              )
            else
              offense_range.source
            end
          source.prepend('.') unless source.start_with?('.')
          source.prepend('&')
        end

        # @param [RuboCop::Cop::Corrector] corrector
        # @param [Parser::Source::Range] offense_range
        # @param [RuboCop::AST::SendNode] send_node
        def autocorrect(corrector, offense_range:, send_node:)
          corrector.replace(
            offense_range,
            add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range: offense_range, send_node: send_node)
          )

          corrector.wrap(send_node, '(', ')') if require_parentheses?(send_node)
        end


        NIL_SPECIFIC_METHODS = (nil.methods - Object.new.methods).to_set.freeze
        SNAKE_CASE = /\A[[:digit:][:upper:]_]+\z/.freeze

        def_node_matcher :style_modifier_if_safe_navigation_candidate, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (if {
                  (send $_ {:nil? :!})
                  $_
                } nil? $_)

            (if {
                  (send (send $_ :nil?) :!)
                  $_
                } $_ nil?)
          }
        PATTERN

        def_node_matcher :style_ternary_safe_navigation_candidate, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (if (send $_ {:nil? :!}) nil $_)

            (if (send (send $_ :nil?) :!) $_ nil)

            (if $_ $_ nil)
          }
        PATTERN

        def_node_matcher :style_and_with_rhs_or?, '(and _ {or (begin or)})'
        def_node_matcher :style_not_nil_check?, '(send (send $_ :nil?) :!)'
        def_node_matcher :style_and_inside_begin?, '`(begin and ...)'
        def_node_matcher :style_strip_begin, '{ (begin $!begin) $!(begin) }'

        def_node_matcher :redundant_respond_to_nil_specific_method?, <<~PATTERN
          (csend _ :respond_to? (sym %NIL_SPECIFIC_METHODS))
        PATTERN

        def_node_matcher :redundant_conversion_with_default?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (or $(csend _ :to_h) (hash))
            (or (block $(csend _ :to_h) ...) (hash))
            (or $(csend _ :to_a) (array))
            (or $(csend _ :to_i) (int 0))
            (or $(csend _ :to_f) (float 0.0))
            (or $(csend _ :to_s) (str empty?))
          }
        PATTERN

        def_node_matcher :empty_safe_navigation_in_conditional?, <<~PATTERN
          (if (csend (send ...) :empty?) ...)
        PATTERN

        def apply_style_safe_navigation_if(host, node)
          return if style_allowed_if_condition?(node)

          checked_variable, receiver, method_chain, _method = style_extract_parts_from_if(node)
          return unless style_offending_node?(host, node, checked_variable, method_chain, receiver)

          body = style_extract_if_body(node)
          method_call = receiver.parent

          removal_ranges = [style_begin_range(host, node, body), style_end_range(host, node, body)]

          style_report_offense(host, node, method_chain, method_call, *removal_ranges) do |corrector|
            corrector.insert_before(method_call.loc.dot, '&') unless method_call.safe_navigation?
          end
        end

        def apply_style_safe_navigation_and(host, node)
          style_collect_and_clauses(node).each do |(lhs, lhs_operator_range), (rhs, _rhs_operator_range)|
            lhs_not_nil_check = style_not_nil_check?(lhs)
            lhs_receiver = lhs_not_nil_check || lhs
            rhs_receiver = style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(style_strip_begin(rhs), lhs_receiver)

            next if !host.cop_config['ConvertCodeThatCanStartToReturnNil'] && lhs_not_nil_check
            next unless style_offending_node?(host, node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)

            lhs_method_chain = style_find_method_chain(lhs_receiver)
            next unless lhs_method_chain == lhs_receiver || lhs_not_nil_check

            style_report_offense(
              host,
              node,
              rhs, rhs_receiver,
              host.send(:range_with_surrounding_space, range: lhs.source_range, side: :right),
              host.send(:range_with_surrounding_space, range: lhs_operator_range, side: :right),
              offense_range: host.send(:range_between, lhs.source_range.begin_pos, rhs.source_range.end_pos)
            )
          end
        end

        def style_report_offense(host, node, rhs, rhs_receiver, *removal_ranges, offense_range: node)
          host.add_offense(offense_range) do |corrector|
            next if style_and_with_rhs_or?(node)

            removal_ranges.each { |range| corrector.remove(range) }
            yield corrector if block_given?

            style_handle_comments(host, corrector, node, rhs)

            style_add_safe_nav_to_all_methods_in_chain(corrector, rhs_receiver, rhs)
          end
        end

        def style_find_method_chain(node)
          return node unless node&.parent&.call_type?

          style_find_method_chain(node.parent)
        end

        def style_collect_and_clauses(node)
          node.each_descendant(:and)
              .inject(style_and_parts(node)) { |nodes, and_node| style_concat_nodes(nodes, and_node) }
              .sort_by { |part| part.is_a?(RuboCop::AST::Node) ? part.source_range.begin_pos : part.begin_pos }
              .each_slice(2)
              .each_cons(2)
        end

        def style_concat_nodes(nodes, and_node)
          return nodes if and_node.each_ancestor(:block).any?

          nodes.concat(style_and_parts(and_node))
        end

        def style_and_parts(node)
          parts = [node.loc.operator]
          parts << node.rhs unless style_and_inside_begin?(node.rhs)
          parts << node.lhs unless node.lhs.and_type? || style_and_inside_begin?(node.lhs)
          parts
        end

        def style_offending_node?(host, node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)
          return false if lhs_receiver != rhs_receiver || rhs_receiver.nil?
          return false if style_use_var_only_in_unless_modifier?(node, lhs_receiver)
          return false if style_chain_length(rhs, rhs_receiver) > style_max_chain_length(host)
          return false if style_unsafe_method_used?(host, rhs, rhs_receiver.parent)
          return false if rhs.send_type? && rhs.method?(:empty?)

          true
        end

        def style_use_var_only_in_unless_modifier?(node, variable)
          node.if_type? && node.unless? && !style_method_called?(variable)
        end

        def style_extract_if_body(node)
          if node.ternary?
            node.branches.find { |branch| !branch.nil_type? }
          else
            node.node_parts[1]
          end
        end

        def style_handle_comments(host, corrector, node, method_call)
          comments = style_comments(host, node)
          return if comments.empty?

          corrector.insert_before(method_call, "#{comments.map(&:text).join("\n")}\n")
        end

        def style_comments(host, node)
          style_relevant_comment_ranges(node).each.with_object([]) do |range, comments|
            comments.concat(host.processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(range).to_a)
          end
        end

        def style_relevant_comment_ranges(node)
          begin_pos = node.loc.first_line
          end_pos = node.loc.last_line

          node.child_nodes.each.with_object([]) do |child, ranges|
            ranges << (begin_pos...child.loc.first_line)
            begin_pos = child.loc.last_line
          end << (begin_pos...end_pos)
        end

        def style_allowed_if_condition?(node)
          node.else? || node.elsif?
        end

        def style_extract_parts_from_if(node)
          variable, receiver =
            if node.ternary?
              style_ternary_safe_navigation_candidate(node)
            else
              style_modifier_if_safe_navigation_candidate(node)
            end

          checked_variable, matching_receiver, method = style_extract_common_parts(receiver, variable)

          matching_receiver = nil if receiver && RuboCop::Cop::Style::SafeNavigation::LOGIC_JUMP_KEYWORDS.include?(receiver.type)

          [checked_variable, matching_receiver, receiver, method]
        end

        def style_extract_common_parts(method_chain, checked_variable)
          matching_receiver = style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(method_chain, checked_variable)

          method = matching_receiver.parent if matching_receiver

          [checked_variable, matching_receiver, method]
        end

        def style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(method_chain, checked_variable)
          return nil unless method_chain.respond_to?(:receiver)

          receiver = method_chain.receiver

          return receiver if receiver == checked_variable

          style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(receiver, checked_variable)
        end

        def style_chain_length(method_chain, method)
          method.each_ancestor(:send, :csend).inject(0) do |total, ancestor|
            break total + 1 if ancestor == method_chain

            total + 1
          end
        end

        def style_unsafe_method_used?(host, method_chain, method)
          return true if style_unsafe_method?(method)

          method.each_ancestor(:send).any? do |ancestor|
            break true unless host.config.cop_enabled?('Lint/SafeNavigationChain')

            break true if style_unsafe_method?(ancestor)
            break true if host.send(:nil_methods).include?(ancestor.method_name)
            break false if ancestor == method_chain
          end
        end

        def style_unsafe_method?(send_node)
          style_negated?(send_node) ||
            send_node.assignment? ||
            (!send_node.dot? && !send_node.safe_navigation?)
        end

        def style_negated?(send_node)
          if style_method_called?(send_node)
            style_negated?(send_node.parent)
          else
            send_node.send_type? && send_node.method?(:!)
          end
        end

        def style_method_called?(send_node)
          send_node&.parent&.send_type?
        end

        def style_begin_range(host, node, method_call)
          host.send(:range_between, node.source_range.begin_pos, method_call.source_range.begin_pos)
        end

        def style_end_range(host, node, method_call)
          host.send(:range_between, method_call.source_range.end_pos, node.source_range.end_pos)
        end

        def style_add_safe_nav_to_all_methods_in_chain(corrector, start_method, method_chain)
          start_method.each_ancestor do |ancestor|
            break unless %i[send block].include?(ancestor.type)
            next unless ancestor.send_type?
            next if ancestor.safe_navigation?

            corrector.insert_before(ancestor.loc.dot, '&')

            break if ancestor == method_chain
          end
        end

        def style_max_chain_length(host)
          host.cop_config.fetch('MaxChainLength', 2)
        end

        def apply_style_chain_length_csend(host, node)
          chains = style_chain_length_chains(node)
          limit = style_chain_length_max(host)
          return if chains.size < limit

          host.add_offense(
            chains.last,
            message: format(RuboCop::Cop::Style::SafeNavigationChainLength::MSG, max: limit)
          )
        end

        def style_chain_length_chains(node)
          node.each_ancestor.with_object([]) do |parent, chains|
            break chains unless parent.csend_type?

            chains << parent
          end
        end

        def style_chain_length_max(host)
          host.cop_config['Max'] || 2
        end

        def apply_empty_safe_navigation_if(host, node)
          return unless empty_safe_navigation_in_conditional?(node)

          condition = node.condition

          host.add_offense(condition) do |corrector|
            receiver = condition.receiver.source

            corrector.replace(condition, "#{receiver} && #{receiver}.#{condition.method_name}")
          end
        end

        def apply_consistency_and(host, node)
          all_operands = consistency_collect_operands(node, [])
          operand_groups = all_operands.group_by { |operand| consistency_receiver_name_as_key(operand, +'') }

          operand_groups.each_value do |grouped_operands|
            next unless (dot_op, begin_of_rest_operands = consistency_find_consistent_parts(host, grouped_operands))

            rest_operands = grouped_operands[begin_of_rest_operands..]
            rest_operands.each do |operand|
              next if consistency_already_appropriate_call?(operand, dot_op)

              consistency_register_offense(host, operand, dot_op)
            end
          end
        end

        def consistency_collect_operands(node, operand_nodes)
          consistency_operand_nodes(node.lhs, operand_nodes)
          consistency_operand_nodes(node.rhs, operand_nodes)

          operand_nodes
        end

        def consistency_receiver_name_as_key(method, fully_receivers)
          if method.parent.call_type?
            consistency_receiver_name_as_key(method.parent, fully_receivers)
          else
            fully_receivers << method.receiver&.source.to_s
          end
        end

        def consistency_find_consistent_parts(host, grouped_operands)
          csend_in_and, csend_in_or, send_in_and, send_in_or = consistency_most_left_indices(host, grouped_operands)

          return if csend_in_and && csend_in_or && csend_in_and < csend_in_or

          if csend_in_and
            ['.', (send_in_and ? [send_in_and, csend_in_and].min : csend_in_and) + 1]
          elsif send_in_or && csend_in_or
            send_in_or < csend_in_or ? ['.', send_in_or + 1] : ['&.', csend_in_or + 1]
          elsif send_in_and && csend_in_or && send_in_and < csend_in_or
            ['.', csend_in_or]
          end
        end

        def consistency_already_appropriate_call?(operand, dot_op)
          return true if operand.safe_navigation? && dot_op == '&.'

          (operand.dot? || operand.operator_method?) && dot_op == '.'
        end

        def consistency_register_offense(host, operand, dot_operator)
          offense_range = operand.operator_method? ? operand : operand.loc.dot
          message = if dot_operator == '.'
                      RuboCop::Cop::Lint::SafeNavigationConsistency::USE_DOT_MSG
                    else
                      RuboCop::Cop::Lint::SafeNavigationConsistency::USE_SAFE_NAVIGATION_MSG
                    end

          host.add_offense(offense_range, message: message) do |corrector|
            next if operand.operator_method?

            corrector.replace(operand.loc.dot, dot_operator)
          end
        end

        def consistency_operand_nodes(operand, operand_nodes)
          if operand.operator_keyword?
            consistency_collect_operands(operand, operand_nodes)
          elsif operand.call_type?
            operand_nodes << operand
          end
        end

        def consistency_most_left_indices(host, grouped_operands)
          indices = { csend_in_and: nil, csend_in_or: nil, send_in_and: nil, send_in_or: nil }

          grouped_operands.each_with_index do |operand, index|
            indices[:csend_in_and] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_and?(operand) && operand.csend_type?
            indices[:csend_in_or] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_or?(operand) && operand.csend_type?
            indices[:send_in_and] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_and?(operand) && !consistency_nilable?(host, operand)
            indices[:send_in_or] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_or?(operand) && !consistency_nilable?(host, operand)
          end

          indices.values
        end

        def consistency_operand_in_and?(node)
          return true if node.parent.and_type?

          parent = node.parent.parent while node.parent.begin_type?

          parent&.and_type?
        end

        def consistency_operand_in_or?(node)
          return true if node.parent.or_type?

          parent = node.parent.parent while node.parent.begin_type?

          parent&.or_type?
        end

        def consistency_nilable?(host, node)
          node.csend_type? || host.send(:nil_methods).include?(node.method_name)
        end

        def apply_redundant_csend(host, node)
          unless redundant_assume_receiver_instance_exists?(node.receiver)
            return unless redundant_check?(node) && host.send(:allowed_method?, node.method_name)
            return if redundant_respond_to_nil_specific_method?(node)
          end

          range = node.loc.dot
          host.add_offense(range) { |corrector| corrector.replace(range, '.') }
        end

        def apply_redundant_or(host, node)
          redundant_conversion_with_default?(node) do |send_node|
            range = send_node.loc.dot.begin.join(node.source_range.end)

            host.add_offense(range, message: RuboCop::Cop::Lint::RedundantSafeNavigation::MSG_LITERAL) do |corrector|
              corrector.replace(send_node.loc.dot, '.')

              range_with_default = node.lhs.source_range.end.begin.join(node.source_range.end)
              corrector.remove(range_with_default)
            end
          end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # The safe navigation operator returns nil if the receiver is
      # nil. If you chain an ordinary method call after a safe
      # navigation operator, it raises NoMethodError. We should use a
      # safe navigation operator after a safe navigation operator.
      # This cop checks for the problem outlined above.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop's autocorrection is unsafe because it changes the behavior of
      #   the code: `x&.foo.bar` raises `NoMethodError` when `x` or `x&.foo` is `nil`,
      #   whereas the corrected `x&.foo&.bar` returns `nil` instead. The autocorrection
      #   also assumes that extending safe navigation through the chain is intended,
      #   while removing the first `&.` may be what was intended instead.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   x&.foo.bar
      #   x&.foo + bar
      #   x&.foo[bar]
      #
      #   # good
      #   x&.foo&.bar
      #   x&.foo || bar
      class SafeNavigationChain < Base
        include NilMethods
        extend AutoCorrector
        extend TargetRubyVersion

        minimum_target_ruby_version 2.3

        MSG = 'Do not chain ordinary method call after safe navigation operator.'
        PLUS_MINUS_METHODS = %i[+@ -@].freeze

        # @!method bad_method?(node)
        def_node_matcher :bad_method?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (send $(csend ...) $_ ...)
            (send $(any_block (csend ...) ...) $_ ...)
            (send $(begin (csend ...)) $_ ...)
          }
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable-next Metrics/AbcSize
        def on_send(node)
          return unless require_safe_navigation?(node)

          bad_method?(node) do |safe_nav, method|
            return if nil_methods.include?(method) || PLUS_MINUS_METHODS.include?(node.method_name)
            return if ternary_safe_navigation?(node, safe_nav)

            begin_range = node.loc.dot || safe_nav.source_range.end
            location = begin_range.join(node.source_range.end)

            add_offense(location) do |corrector|
              next if ternary_else_branch?(node, safe_nav)

              autocorrect(corrector, offense_range: location, send_node: node)
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def require_safe_navigation?(node)
          parent = node.parent
          return true unless parent&.and_type?

          parent.rhs != node || parent.lhs.receiver != parent.rhs.receiver
        end

        def ternary_safe_navigation?(node, safe_nav)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.if_type? && node.equal?(parent.if_branch) && parent.condition == safe_nav
        end

        def ternary_else_branch?(node, safe_nav)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.if_type? && node.equal?(parent.else_branch) && parent.condition == safe_nav
        end

        # @param [Parser::Source::Range] offense_range
        # @param [RuboCop::AST::SendNode] send_node
        # @return [String]
        def add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range:, send_node:)
          source =
            if brackets?(send_node)
              format(
                '%<method_name>s(%<arguments>s)%<method_chain>s',
                arguments: send_node.arguments.map(&:source).join(', '),
                method_name: send_node.method_name,
                method_chain: send_node.source_range.end.join(send_node.source_range.end).source
              )
            else
              offense_range.source
            end
          source.prepend('.') unless source.start_with?('.')
          source.prepend('&')
        end

        # @param [RuboCop::Cop::Corrector] corrector
        # @param [Parser::Source::Range] offense_range
        # @param [RuboCop::AST::SendNode] send_node
        def autocorrect(corrector, offense_range:, send_node:)
          corrector.replace(
            offense_range,
            add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range: offense_range, send_node: send_node)
          )

          corrector.wrap(send_node, '(', ')') if require_parentheses?(send_node)
        end

        def brackets?(send_node)
          send_node.method?(:[]) || send_node.method?(:[]=)
        end

        def require_parentheses?(send_node)
          return true if operator_inside_collection_literal?(send_node)
          return false unless send_node.comparison_method?
          return false unless (node = send_node.parent)

          (node.respond_to?(:logical_operator?) && node.logical_operator?) ||
            (node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?)
        end

        def operator_inside_collection_literal?(send_node)
          # If an operator call (without a dot) is inside an array or a hash, it needs
          # to be parenthesized when converted to safe navigation.
          send_node.parent&.type?(:array, :pair) && !send_node.loc.dot
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
